تعرنكسوا (form IIIq)
# تَعْرَنْكِسُوا (taʕrankisū) /taʕ.ran.ki.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# تُعْرَنْكَسُوا (tuʕrankasū) /tuʕ.ran.ka.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
